name: Sacred Island of Okinoshima and Associated Sites in the Munakata Region
description: Okinoshima is a small, forested island about 60 km off Kyushu's western coast, still treated as a sacred place within the Munakata Grand Shrine. Between the 4th and 9th centuries, people left offerings among its rocks, many of them finely made pieces brought from Korea and the Asian mainland. These largely undisturbed deposits reveal how ancient Japan's sea contacts and rituals developed.
